svg.title: Dark Blue Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting primary Pace photograph. Four straight edges and clockwise lean retained. Approximate geometry; interpretive blue palette, not calibrated paint. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
